description: PHP is a language often used to build the part of a website that works on a server. These 12 starter lessons use small examples and simple words. Read the result, make one small change, and try the practice question. Install PHP 8.2 or later. Save each example as lesson.php and run php lesson.php. These are local programs, not a server for this learning site.
versionNote: Examples use PHP 8.2 or later and the command line.
whatYouWillLearn: Name a set of steps with PHP
learningObjectives: Store a short list with PHP
